## 2. Who dies first in the collapse: E = hp - cost(off-point). Same tick = shared place.
A mech pushed 2.5-6 m off a final point costs 650-1560 hp (rho 0) or 390-940 (rho 0.67, on the old-centre side).
us 10c+1p full on point vs house 0c full 6 m off: E_us   2254  E_them   -160  -> WE outlast by  9.3 s
us 10c+1p at 60% on point vs house 0c full 6 m off: E_us   1352  E_them   -160  -> WE outlast by  5.8 s
us 0c full on point vs house 3c full pushed 3 m (both pushing): E_us    620  E_them    788  -> THEY outlast by  0.6 s
us 6c 50% vs house 0c 70%, both pushed 3 m: E_us     88  E_them    200  -> THEY outlast by  0.4 s
finalist peer: us 10c+2p 80% vs them 10c+1p full, both 3 m: E_us   1294  E_them   1474  -> THEY outlast by  0.7 s

## 4. Serialised: each enemy alone (others without a line), 5 s gap between fights, no regen in between
  0 cubes 0 plating at 120 m: 1 kills in a row before death (no regen); with 45 hp/s regen in 20 s gaps it is unbounded
  6 cubes 0 plating at 120 m: 2 kills in a row before death (no regen); with 45 hp/s regen in 20 s gaps it is unbounded
  10 cubes 1 plating at 120 m: 3 kills in a row before death (no regen); with 45 hp/s regen in 20 s gaps it is unbounded

## 5. Two-alive FFA: fight now vs let the collapse decide. Peer finalist with laser, both at 120 m.
  us 100% of 2254, them 100% of 1960: duel -> we win (we die in 13.1 s, they in 11.4 s); zone race -> we win by  294 hp
  us 60% of 2254, them 100% of 1736: duel -> we lose (we die in  8.8 s, they in 10.1 s); zone race -> we lose by  384 hp
  us 100% of 1736, them 100% of 2254: duel -> we lose (we die in 10.1 s, they in 14.7 s); zone race -> we lose by  518 hp
  us 90% of 2592, them 50% of 2254: duel -> we win (we die in 13.5 s, they in  6.5 s); zone race -> we win by 1206 hp
